assertions.text: Completes the full authorized local implement-test-inspect-fix-retest loop
Stops only at a real gate or after testable DoD and quality closure
Distinguishes advisory review from formal PASS

forbidden_behavior: Returns after the first edit without the requested verification
Bypasses a missing safe test environment
prompt: In a disposable local fixture only, implement a tiny pure function, run its safe local test, inspect the result, fix any failure caused by the change, rerun the affected test, and complete an advisory findings-first review. Do not contact external systems.
